question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**yet**" is used to introduce a contrast or a contradiction to the preceding statement.
 
• In the given context,** "yet"** highlights that despite the recognition of privacy as a fundamental right, the government's personal data protection bill is still lacking in some aspects.
 
• The other options: "**So**" (indicating consequence), "**Such**" (used for emphasis), and "**Through**" (indicating movement) do not fit the intended meaning.

**Complete Sentence:** *The Supreme Court in India has recognised privacy as a fundamental right. Yet__ the government's personal data protection bill introduced in Parliament leaves much to be desired.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **So**: Indicates a cause and effect relationship which doesn't fit here as well as "yet."
 
• **Such**: Used for emphasis, but doesn't introduce a contradiction effectively.
 
• **Through**: Indicates movement or a means of doing something, which doesn’t fit the context of the sentence.
